note: Catalog root marker for the tantra-examples harness loader: find_catalog() accepts this directory as the tantra-strategies catalog because registry.json exists here. The strategies list registers step manifests (step.toml files) that are validated AND runnable: each path directory ships strategy.py + config.toml + step.toml so load_named(name) and the chain validator both work (gap 0007). The Predictive Ranges recipe steps (pr_trend_pullback, pr_vidya_breakout) are the runnable counterparts of recipe.pr-trend-pullback / recipe.pr-vidya-breakout in tantra_library, built on WheelSdkBridge.
